description:
## Problem
- `benchbox tuning validate <file> --platform datafusion` always validates the file as a DataFrame configuration, because SQL `datafusion` shares the DataFrame template entries. A SQL DataFusion tuning file therefore cannot be validated.
- `_dataframe_profile_path` in benchbox/cli/tuning_resolver.py would hand a DataFrame profile to a SQL-mode DataFusion run if `examples/tunings/dataframe/datafusion_optimized.yaml` is ever added.

## Change
- Decide the validate-mode selection for platforms that exist in both SQL and DataFrame modes (explicit flag or inferring from the file contents) and implement it with tests.
- Make the profile resolution mode-aware so a DataFrame profile is only chosen for a DataFrame run; add a test that would fail if a datafusion profile file appeared.
- Document the rule in docs/reference/cli/tuning.md.

## Guardrails
- Existing DataFrame validate behaviour for polars, pandas and cuDF is unchanged.
